Introduction

This procedure details the testing procedures I1, which recommended to be carried 
out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
Safety Precautions

 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Wear your safety equipment as helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass...etc.
